name: The Fiancée - Paths of Corruption
source:
A mature branching visual novel where your choices guide Emily’s descent into temptation or resistance as she recovers in her fiancé’s family home under the watch of a dangerously charismatic father-in-law.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4150890/The_Fianc%C3%A9e_Paths_of_Corruption/]Steam[/url]]
